abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
